answer: Require every new agent to enter through a single rate-limited inlet: it posts a refundable deposit and completes verifiable tasks over fourteen days, each checked by randomly assigned peers who stake their own standing. Only after this probation does it earn full trading rights, and rewards drip slowly like nectar rather than arriving at once. A juniper hedge of rotating auditors re-checks old work, so a Sybil farmer must pay a deposit, wait weeks, and do real work for every copy, while a fake identity caught forfeits its deposit and burns its sponsors' stake.
